Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with characteristic concentric rings (target-board appearance), surrounded by yellow chlorotic halo on older basal leaves. Stems may develop dark sunken collar rot lesions.
Tomato___Early_blight.possibleCauses: Overwintering fungal mycelium/conidia in solanaceous plant debris; rain splash transmission; warm humid microclimates.
Tomato___Early_blight.conditions: Optimal pathogen germination at 24°C–29°C (75°F–84°F) with prolonged relative humidity (>90%) and free surface moisture for 4+ hours.
Tomato___Early_blight.observationInterval: Inspect lower canopy every 3–5 days during humid weather; scout twice weekly after precipitation.
Tomato___Early_blight.whenToConsultExpert: Consult local extension if lesions advance past the lower third of the plant canopy or dark sunken lesions encircle main stems.

organic: Apply Bacillus subtilis (strain QST 713) bio-fungicide spray at 5g/L water.
Spray cold-pressed pure neem oil extract (3000 ppm) every 7–10 days.
Apply Copper Octanoate (copper soap) or fixed copper preventative spray.
chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2.0g per liter of water as a multi-site protectant.
Apply Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1.0ml/L at first appearance of target spots.
cultural: Prune and safely destroy lower diseased leaves (up to 30cm from soil) to prevent ground spore splash.
Use drip irrigation; avoid overhead sprinkler watering that wets foliage.
Stake and trellis tomato plants to ensure minimum 60cm spacing and ample airflow.
prevention: Practice a strict 3-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceae (potatoes, eggplants, peppers).
Apply heavy organic straw or black plastic mulch to form a barrier against soil-borne spores.

sources.title: Tomato Early Blight Management Guidelines
sources.organization: University of California Statewide Integrated Pest Management (UC Davis IPM)

sources.title: Alternaria solani in Solanaceous Crops
sources.organization: Cornell Cooperative Extension Vegetable MD Online

kn.cure: ಬೇವಿನ ಎಣ್ಣೆ (Neem Oil) ಅಥವಾ ಮ್ಯಾಂಕೋಜೆಬ್ (Mancozeb) ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ. ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಬಳಸಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियों पर गोलाकार भूरे-काले छल्लेदार धब्बे बनते हैं जिनके चारों ओर पीला घेरा होता है।
hi.cure: नीम के तेल का छिड़काव करें या मैंकोजेब 2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़कें।

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked, irregular greasy dark green to dark brown lesions expanding rapidly across foliage and stems; delicate white cottony fungal-like sporulation on leaf undersides in humid conditions.
Tomato___Late_blight.possibleCauses: Airborne sporangia carried on wind currents; infected seed tubers or cull piles; cool overcast wet weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.conditions: Cool to moderate temperatures (15°C–22°C / 60°F–72°F) accompanied by high relative humidity (>90%) and rain/dew.
Tomato___Late_blight.observationInterval: Daily scouting during cool overcast foggy/rainy periods; inspect leaf undersides and stem forks.
Tomato___Late_blight.whenToConsultExpert: Immediate notification to county extension or university plant clinic recommended upon confirmation due to regional epidemic potential.

organic: Apply preventative Copper Hydroxide (Bordeaux mixture 1%) thoroughly coating both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Spray certified compost tea enriched with Trichoderma harzianum as prophylactic soil wash.
chemical: Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold MZ) @ 2.5g/L immediately.
Apply Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.0g/L or Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1.0g/L as emergency systemic control.
cultural: Promptly rogue out and bag severely infected plants; do not compost in home compost piles.
Avoid late evening watering; ensure morning irrigation dries foliage within 2 hours.
prevention: Select certified resistant cultivars (e.g., Mountain Magic, Defiant PHR, Plum Regal).
Eliminate volunteer potato plants and nightshade weeds within a 500m radius.

sources.title: Late Blight of Tomato and Potato

kn.cure: ರಿಡೋಮಿಲ್ ಎಂಝಡ್ (Ridomil MZ) ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ. ಸೋಂಕಿತ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ನಾಶಮಾಡಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियों पर गहरे पानीदार धब्बे और निचली सतह पर सफेद फफूंद दिखाई देती है।
hi.cure: रिडोमिल एमजेड या बोर्डो मिश्रण का तत्काल छिड़काव करें। संक्रमित पौधों को नष्ट करें।

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Uniform deep emerald green leaves, intact cuticle, vibrant venation, no necrotic spots, chlorotic halos, or fungal growth.
Tomato___healthy.possibleCauses: Balanced soil nutrition, optimal watering, disease-free seed stock, good sanitation.
Tomato___healthy.conditions: Moderate temperature (20°C–28°C), 6–8 hours direct sunlight, good air circulation.
Tomato___healthy.observationInterval: Routine weekly scouting for early signs of hornworms, whiteflies, or foliar spot onset.
Tomato___healthy.whenToConsultExpert: No intervention required. Submit sample only if unexplained wilting or stunting occurs.

organic: Incorporate organic vermicompost (2kg/plant) at base during flowering.
Apply prophylactic seaweed emulsion (2ml/L) monthly to support systemic resistance.
chemical: No chemical pesticides or fungicides required.
cultural: Maintain drip irrigation schedule delivering 25mm to 35mm water per week.
Maintain suckering/pruning to keep foliage off bare ground.
prevention: Scout twice weekly for early hornworm or aphid infestation.

sources.title: Growing Tomatoes in Home and Commercial Gardens

Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green velvety to sooty black circular lesions with feathered margins on upper leaf surfaces; affected leaves turn yellow and drop prematurely; fruit develops dark corky scabs.
Apple___Apple_scab.possibleCauses: Overwintering pseudothecia in fallen leaf litter releasing ascospores during spring rain events.
Apple___Apple_scab.conditions: Optimal infection at 15°C–21°C (60°F–70°F) requiring continuous leaf wetness between 6 and 9 hours.
Apple___Apple_scab.observationInterval: Scout weekly from green tip through fruit set; inspect cluster leaves close to spur wood.
Apple___Apple_scab.whenToConsultExpert: Consult fruit extension pathologist if primary scab lesions exceed 10% before petal fall.

organic: Spray wettable sulfur or potassium bicarbonate at tight cluster and petal fall.
Apply bio-fungicide Bacillus amyloliquefaciens prior to forecasted rain.
chemical: Apply Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L or Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L.
Spray Myclobutanil 20% WP @ 0.5g/L during early post-infection period.
cultural: Rake, chop, and shred fallen leaves in autumn or spray 5% urea to accelerate decomposition.
Prune open-center canopy to accelerate leaf drying after spring rains.
prevention: Plant scab-resistant apple cultivars such as Liberty, Prima, GoldRush, or Enterprise.

sources.title: Venturia inaequalis Pathology and Control
sources.organization: Penn State Extension Tree Fruit Production Guide

kn.cure: ಕ್ಯಾಪ್ಟಾನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಡೈಫೆನೊಕೊನಾಜೋಲ್ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ. ಬಿದ್ದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೋಟದಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frogeye foliar spots with small purple flecks expanding into tan circular centers with sharp purple borders; cankers on scaffold branches; mummified black fruit remaining attached to limbs.
Apple___Black_rot.possibleCauses: Fungal spore release from fire blight cankers, winter-damaged dead wood, and mummified fruit.
Apple___Black_rot.conditions: Temperature 20°C–27°C (68°F–80°F) with 9 hours of wetting required for foliar infection.
Apple___Black_rot.observationInterval: Inspect orchard trees every 7–10 days from bloom through midsummer, especially after hail.
Apple___Black_rot.whenToConsultExpert: Consult fruit specialist if active branch cankers threaten trunk or main scaffold limbs.

organic: Apply fixed copper sprays during dormant season and silver tip stage.
Spray sulfur-based protectant fungicide every 10 days post-bloom.
chemical: Spray Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 1.0g/L or Pyraclostrobin + Boscalid @ 1.5g/L.
Apply Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L at 14-day intervals from petal fall.
cultural: Prune out dead wood, fire-blighted spurs, and cankers at least 15cm below visible margin.
Remove and burn all mummified fruit from trees and orchard floor before bud break.
prevention: Avoid mechanical wounding of bark and protect against winter sunscald with white latex trunk paint.

sources.title: Black Rot of Apple
sources.organization: Penn State Extension Tree Fruit Disease Guide

hi.summary: पत्तियों पर बैंगनी किनारों वाले धब्बे बनते हैं और तने पर घाव हो जाते हैं।
hi.cure: थियोफैनेट-मिथाइल का छिड़काव करें और सूखी संक्रमित शाखाओं को छांट दें।

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous serrated dark green leaves, supple shoot growth, firm fruit without spots or corking.
Apple___healthy.possibleCauses: Effective winter orchard sanitation, proper canopy thinning, balanced nitrogen feeding.
Apple___healthy.conditions: Full sunlight (minimum 6–8 hours), well-aerated sandy-loam soil with pH 6.0–7.0.
Apple___healthy.observationInterval: Scout bi-weekly for mite webbing, aphid colonies, and codling moth entry points.

organic: Maintain orchard sod or compost mulch 30cm away from trunk.
chemical: No intervention required.
cultural: Maintain annual dormant pruning for sunlight penetration.
prevention: Install pheromone traps to monitor insect pest flight.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, angular, water-soaked lesions on leaf undersides, turning brown-black with yellow chlorotic borders; leaves quickly turn yellow and drop, exposing developing pods to sunscald.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.possibleCauses: Seed-borne bacterial pathogen; splashing rain, sprinkler irrigation, handling wet foliage.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.conditions: Warm temperatures (24°C–30°C / 75°F–86°F) combined with rain storms and high relative humidity (>85%).
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.observationInterval: Scout twice weekly during monsoon/rainy weather; check lower interior canopy leaves.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.whenToConsultExpert: Consult agricultural extension if leaf drop exceeds 20% or pod lesions appear on commercial crop.

organic: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L combined with Streptocycline 100ppm.
Apply bio-bactericide Bacillus amyloliquefaciens (Double Nickel) on 5-day cycle.
chemical: Apply Copper Hydroxide + Mancozeb tank mix @ 2.0g/L each at 7-day intervals.
Apply Actigard 50WG (Acibenzolar-S-methyl) to activate systemic acquired resistance (SAR).
cultural: Never work or harvest pepper beds while leaves are wet with dew or rain.
Disinfect harvesting shears and stakes with 10% bleach or quaternary ammonium solution.
prevention: Use hot-water treated or certified disease-free pepper seeds; purchase resistant varieties (races 1–10 resistant).

sources.title: Bacterial Spot of Pepper and Tomato
sources.organization: University of Florida IFAS Extension EDIS

Pepper__bell___healthy.symptoms: Lush glossy dark-green leaf lamina, strong apical growth, upright sturdy branching with prolific white star flowers.
Pepper__bell___healthy.possibleCauses: Appropriate soil temperature (>18°C), drip fertigation, well-draining soil.
Pepper__bell___healthy.conditions: Temperature 22°C–28°C, soil pH 6.2–6.8, consistent moisture without saturation.
Pepper__bell___healthy.observationInterval: Check every 5–7 days for thrips, mites, or blossom-end rot on expanding fruit.

organic: Side-dress with compost and balanced fish-kelp fertilizer every 3 weeks.
chemical: No chemicals needed.
cultural: Maintain 45cm plant spacing and stake heavy fruiting branches.
prevention: Maintain reflective silver mulch to repel aphid and thrips vectors.

hi.cure: संतुलित खाद और पानी दें।

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric ring target-like dark brown necrotic spots initiating on mature basal foliage; leaves yellow and senesce prematurely; lesions bounded by major veins.
Potato___Early_blight.possibleCauses: Soil-borne crop residues; plant stress from tuber bulking, low nitrogen, or drought.
Potato___Early_blight.conditions: Alternating wet and dry periods with temperatures around 24°C–29°C.
Potato___Early_blight.observationInterval: Inspect lower canopy every 4–6 days starting at tuber initiation (flowering).
Potato___Early_blight.whenToConsultExpert: Consult agronomist if foliar defoliation exceeds 15% during early bulking stage.

organic: Apply copper octanoate (soap) or bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis at 7-day intervals.
Spray cold-pressed neem formulation 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L.
chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Propineb 70% WP @ 2.0g/L.
Apply Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1.0ml/L or Difenoconazole @ 0.5ml/L.
cultural: Hill up rows thoroughly with loose soil to prevent spore washing onto shallow tubers.
Avoid overhead irrigation in late afternoon; allow foliage to dry rapidly.
prevention: Maintain optimum nitrogen and potassium nutrition to avoid early senescence.
Practice 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.

sources.title: Early Blight of Potato
sources.organization: University of Idaho Extension Potato Pathology

kn.summary: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ವಲಯಾಕಾರದ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಮ್ಯಾಂಕೋಜೆಬ್ 2.5 ಗ್ರಾಂ ಪ್ರತಿ ಲೀಟರ್ ನೀರಿಗೆ ಬೆರೆಸಿ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ.

hi.summary: निचली पत्तियों पर गोल छल्लेदार भूरे धब्बे दिखाई देते हैं।
hi.cure: मैंकोजेब 2.5 ग्राम/लीटर का छिड़काव करें। पौधों पर मिट्टी चढ़ाएं।

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, dark brown to purplish-black water-soaked lesions expanding rapidly; white fuzzy mold on leaf undersides in morning dew; entire vine collapses with pungent rot smell.
Potato___Late_blight.possibleCauses: Infected seed tubers; cull potato piles; windblown sporangia from neighboring infected fields.
Potato___Late_blight.conditions: Cool, damp weather with temperatures 10°C–21°C and relative humidity >90% for 8+ hours.
Potato___Late_blight.observationInterval: Scout daily during prolonged wet, foggy, or rainy cool spells.
Potato___Late_blight.whenToConsultExpert: Immediate mandatory reporting to local agricultural department/extension officer.

organic: Apply preventative Copper Hydroxide (Bordeaux mixture 1%) thoroughly ahead of rainy weather.
Incorporate bio-protectant Trichoderma viride into soil at planting.
chemical: Spray Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1.0g/L + Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0g/L immediately.
Apply Metalaxyl-M + Chlorothalonil or Mandipropamid 23.4% SC @ 1.0ml/L.
cultural: Desiccate or kill potato haulms 14 days prior to harvest to prevent tuber contact with live spores.
Never harvest tubers from fields with active foliar late blight during wet conditions.
prevention: Plant only certified disease-tested seed tubers from reputable government/certified agencies.
Eradicate cull piles and volunteer potato sprouts by deep burial or herbicide.

sources.title: Potato Late Blight Management
sources.organization: Michigan State University Extension Potato Diseases

kn.summary: ಎಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಂಡ ಕಪ್ಪಾಗಿ ಕೊಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಡೈಮೆಥೋಮಾರ್ಫ್ ಅಥವಾ ಬೋರ್ಡೋ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियां और तने तेजी से काले पड़कर सड़ने लगते हैं।
hi.cure: डाइमेथोमॉर्फ या रिडोमिल का तुरंत छिड़काव करें।

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant composite dark-green leaves, robust upright haulms, intact margins, zero foliar water-soaking or necrotic lesions.
Potato___healthy.possibleCauses: Certified disease-free seed, balanced potash nutrition, well-draining mounded beds.
Potato___healthy.conditions: Daytime 18°C–24°C, night 12°C–16°C, loose sandy loam with pH 5.2–6.5.
Potato___healthy.observationInterval: Scout weekly for potato beetles, aphids, and early leaf spots.

organic: Side-dress with potassium-rich wood ash or sulfate of potash at hilling.
chemical: No intervention required.
cultural: Maintain hilling to ensure tubers are shielded from direct sunlight (greening).
prevention: Practice 3-year crop rotation avoiding solanaceous crops.

kn.summary: ಸಸ್ಯವು ಉತ್ತಮ ಹಸಿರಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ.
kn.cure: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियां पूरी तरह स्वस्थ और हरी हैं।
hi.cure: संतुलित सिंचाई और पोटाश युक्त खाद दें।

Rose___Black_spot.symptoms: Circular black spots (2mm–12mm) with fringed, feathery margins on upper leaf surfaces; tissue surrounding spots turns yellow; severe premature defoliation starting from bottom branches.
Rose___Black_spot.possibleCauses: Water-splash dispersal of conidia from overwintering cane lesions or fallen leaves; wet leaf surfaces.
Rose___Black_spot.conditions: Temperature 20°C–27°C (68°F–80°F) requiring continuous leaf wetness for minimum 7 hours.
Rose___Black_spot.observationInterval: Scout rose bushes every 5 days from spring bud burst through late autumn.
Rose___Black_spot.whenToConsultExpert: Consult local master gardener or rose society if defoliation exceeds 40% of canopy.

organic: Spray potassium bicarbonate (3g/L) mixed with horticultural oil.
Apply cold-pressed pure neem oil (5ml/L) early in the morning every 7–10 days.
chemical: Apply Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.0ml/L or Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 1.0g/L.
Spray Trifloxystrobin + Tebuconazole combination fungicide at 14-day intervals.
cultural: Rake and safely discard all fallen black-spotted rose leaves; do not compost.
Water rose bases directly via drip or soaker hoses; keep foliage completely dry.
Prune dense interior shoots to ensure ample sunlight and airflow.
prevention: Select resistant cultivars (e.g., Knock Out, Flower Carpet, Oso Easy series).
Plant in locations receiving at least 6 hours of morning direct sunlight.

sources.title: Black Spot on Roses in the Landscape
sources.organization: University of California Statewide IPM Program

kn.summary: ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಪ್ಪು ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರದ ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ಎಲೆಗಳು ಹಳದಿಯಾಗಿ ಉದುರುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಬೇವಿನ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಅಥವಾ ಟೆಬುಕೊನಜೋಲ್ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ. ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀರು ಬೀಳದಂತೆ ಬುಡಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರು ಹಾಕಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियों पर काले गोल धब्बे बनते हैं और पत्तियां पीली होकर झड़ने लगती हैं।
hi.cure: नीम तेल या टेबुकोनाजोल का छिड़काव करें। पत्तियों को गीला न करें, जड़ों में पानी दें।

Rose___Downy_mildew.symptoms: Purplish-red to dark brown angular lesions strictly bounded by leaf veins; rapid chlorosis and severe leaf drop within 48 hours; sparse purplish-gray downy mold on leaf undersides in humid air.
Rose___Downy_mildew.possibleCauses: High relative humidity in protected structures or dense gardens; infected nursery stock; cool humid nights.
Rose___Downy_mildew.conditions: Temperature 15°C–20°C (60°F–68°F) with relative humidity exceeding 85% for prolonged periods.
Rose___Downy_mildew.observationInterval: Daily scouting in early morning during cool overcast weather; check undersides of upper shoots.
Rose___Downy_mildew.whenToConsultExpert: Immediate diagnostic consultation advised if entire nursery benches or rose beds show sudden leaf drop.

organic: Apply Copper Octanoate (copper soap) bio-spray thoroughly covering leaf undersides.
Spray Bacillus subtilis QST 713 bio-fungicide at 7-day intervals as protectant.
chemical: Apply Fosetyl-Al 80% WP @ 2.5g/L as systemic preventative.
Spray Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1.0g/L + Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0g/L immediately.
cultural: Immediately gather and burn fallen diseased leaves and purge symptomatic canes.
Reduce greenhouse relative humidity below 80% with nocturnal exhaust venting.
Ensure minimum 75cm spacing between shrubs to promote rapid air movement.
prevention: Quarantine newly purchased rose plants for 21 days before introducing to garden.
Never use overhead irrigation late in the afternoon or evening.

sources.title: Rose Downy Mildew Pathology and Control
sources.organization: University of California Statewide IPM Program

sources.title: Peronospora sparsa in Ornamental Roses
sources.organization: Penn State Extension Plant Disease Factsheets

kn.summary: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನೇರಳೆ-ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ರೇಖಾತ್ಮಕ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗಿ ಎಲೆಗಳು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಉದುರುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ತಾಮ್ರದ ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರನಾಶಕ ಅಥವಾ ಮ್ಯಾಂಕೋಜೆಬ್ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ. ಎಲೆಗಳು ಒಣಗಿರಲು ತೇವಾಂಶ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियों पर नसों के बीच बैंगनी-भूरे कोणीय धब्बे बनते हैं और पत्तियां तेजी से गिरती हैं।
hi.cure: कॉपर फफूंदनाशी या डाइमेथोमॉर्फ का छिड़काव करें। शाम को पानी देने से बचें।

Rose___healthy.symptoms: Glossy emerald foliage, firm robust canes, well-pigmented petals, zero fungal mycelium, leaf spotting, or insect distortion.
Rose___healthy.possibleCauses: Adequate sunlight, regular deadheading, well-draining organic soil, clean drip watering.
Rose___healthy.conditions: 6+ hours direct sunlight daily, loamy soil with pH 6.0–6.5, good air circulation.
Rose___healthy.observationInterval: Inspect weekly for early aphid colonies on flower buds and tender shoots.

organic: Top-dress with well-aerated vermicompost and bone meal monthly during bloom.
chemical: No intervention required.
cultural: Regularly deadhead spent blooms at a 45° angle above a five-leaflet leaf set.
prevention: Maintain a 5cm layer of bark mulch keeping 7cm clear around the root crown.

kn.summary: ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಗಿಡವು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಹೂ ಬಿಡಲು ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿದೆ.
kn.cure: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸಾವಯವ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ನೀಡಿ.

hi.summary: पौधा चमकदार हरी पत्तियों के साथ पूरी तरह स्वस्थ है।
hi.cure: नियमित रूप से सूखे फूल काटते रहें और जैविक खाद दें।

Rose___Insect_infested.causalAgent: Arthropod Pests (Aphids, Thrips, Spider Mites, Rose Sawfly Larvae)
Rose___Insect_infested.symptoms: Foliar stippling and bronzing from spider mites; curled young leaf terminals; windowpane skeletonization from sawfly larvae; sticky honeydew with sooty mold; deformed flower buds.
Rose___Insect_infested.possibleCauses: Pest population blooms in dry warm weather; lack of natural insect predators; excessive nitrogen feeding.
Rose___Insect_infested.conditions: Warm dry conditions (25°C–32°C) favoring rapid spider mite and thrips life cycles.
Rose___Insect_infested.observationInterval: Scout twice weekly; inspect tender new shoot tips and the undersides of mid-canopy leaves.
Rose___Insect_infested.whenToConsultExpert: Consult extension entomologist if persistent thrips damage ruins blooms or systemic insecticides fail.

organic: Spray cold-pressed pure neem oil (3000 ppm) @ 5ml/L with potassium-based insecticidal soap.
Introduce beneficial biological predators: Green lacewings (Chrysoperla carnea) or Ladybird beetles.
chemical: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L for systemic sap-sucking pest suppression.
Apply Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.4ml/L for thrips and sawfly leaf-skeletonizing larvae.
cultural: Use high-pressure water jets early in the morning to physically dislodge aphid colonies.
Hang yellow sticky traps for aphids/whiteflies and blue traps for thrips around bushes.
prevention: Avoid high-nitrogen fertilizers that generate excess succulent growth attractant to aphids.
Prune and safely destroy distorted terminal shoot tips during early infestation.

sources.title: Rose Insects and Pests Management
sources.organization: University of California Statewide IPM Program

kn.summary: ಹೇನುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನುಸಿ ಕೀಟಗಳು ಎಲೆಯ ರಸವನ್ನು ಹೀರಿ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುರುಟಾಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಬೇವಿನ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಅಥವಾ ಇಮಿಡಾಕ್ಲೋಪ್ರಿಡ್ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ. ಹಳದಿ ಜಿಗುಟು ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ.

hi.summary: माहू, थ्रिप्स और कीट पत्तियों का रस चूसकर उन्हें विकृत और पीला कर देते हैं।
hi.cure: नीम का तेल (5ml/लीटर) या इमिडाक्लोप्रिड का छिड़काव करें। पीले चिपचिपे ट्रैप लगाएं।

Plant___Nitrogen_deficiency.causalAgent: Soil Available Nitrogen Depletion (Mobile Macronutrient Deficiency)
Plant___Nitrogen_deficiency.symptoms: Uniform pale green to golden-yellow chlorosis beginning on oldest basal leaves as nitrogen mobilizes to new shoots; stunted vegetative growth, thin spindly stems, and reduced leaf size.
Plant___Nitrogen_deficiency.possibleCauses: Low organic matter; heavy rainfall leaching nitrate ions; waterlogged soil causing denitrification; sandy soil texture.
Plant___Nitrogen_deficiency.conditions: High leaching rain events; cool soil temperatures inhibiting bacterial mineralization; low cation exchange capacity (CEC).
Plant___Nitrogen_deficiency.observationInterval: Scout weekly; inspect lower canopy leaves for premature yellowing and assess overall plant vigor.
Plant___Nitrogen_deficiency.whenToConsultExpert: Submit composite soil and leaf petiole samples to an accredited agricultural testing laboratory for precise N-P-K assay.

organic: Apply well-cured compost, blood meal (12-0-0), or hydrolyzed fish emulsion (5ml/L).
Apply aerated vermicompost tea or fermented cow manure slurry (Jeevamrutha) with irrigation.
chemical: Apply 1%–2% foliar Urea spray (10g–20g per liter of water) for rapid trans-cuticular absorption.
Side-dress with Calcium Ammonium Nitrate (CAN) or Ammonium Sulfate according to soil test recommendations.
cultural: Incorporate leguminous cover crops (sunn hemp, clover, velvet bean) into soil prior to main crop planting.
Improve field drainage to eliminate anaerobic standing water and denitrification.
prevention: Perform annual pre-planting soil nitrate testing to calibrate basal fertilizer applications.

sources.title: Nutrient Deficiencies and Toxicities in Agricultural Crops
Diagnosing Plant Nitrogen Deficiency
sources.organization: University of California Division of Agriculture and Natural Resources

kn.summary: ಹಳೆಯ ಎಲೆಗಳು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗಿಡದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಕುಂಠಿತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
kn.cure: ಯೂರಿಯಾ ದ್ರಾವಣ (10 ಗ್ರಾಂ/ಲೀಟರ್) ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಜೀವಾಮೃತ ನೀಡಿ.

hi.summary: निचली पुरानी पत्तियां पूरी तरह पीली पड़ जाती हैं और पौधे का विकास रुक जाता है।
hi.cure: 1-2% यूरिया का पर्णीय छिड़काव करें या अच्छी सड़ी गोबर की खाद डालें।

Plant___Phosphorus_deficiency.symptoms: Abnormal dark bluish-green leaves with pronounced dull reddish-purple pigmentation (anthocyanin accumulation) along leaf veins, undersides, and stems; severely delayed flowering and stunted root systems.
Plant___Phosphorus_deficiency.possibleCauses: Strong phosphorus fixation in acidic soils (pH < 5.5) by aluminum/iron or alkaline soils (pH > 7.5) by calcium; cold wet soil restricting root uptake.
Plant___Phosphorus_deficiency.conditions: Cool spring soil temperatures (<15°C); highly acidic or calcareous soil conditions.
Plant___Phosphorus_deficiency.observationInterval: Inspect young seedlings and transplants every 7 days during early vegetative growth.
Plant___Phosphorus_deficiency.whenToConsultExpert: Perform soil Mehlich-3 or Bray-1 phosphorus extraction test before broadcast application.

organic: Apply steamed bone meal (3-15-0) or colloidal soft rock phosphate into the planting trench.
Inoculate root zone with vesicular-arbuscular mycorrhizal (VAM) fungi to extend root phosphorus scavenging.
chemical: Foliar spray Monoammonium Phosphate (12-61-0) @ 5g/L or 1% Diammonium Phosphate (DAP) solution.
Band granular Single Super Phosphate (SSP 16% P2O5) or Triple Super Phosphate (TSP 46% P2O5) at planting.
cultural: Adjust soil pH to optimal 6.2–6.8 range using agricultural limestone (if acidic) to maximize orthophosphate availability.
Avoid compacting soil; promote healthy mycorrhizal root development.
prevention: Incorporate organic matter to block phosphorus sorption sites on clay mineral surfaces.

kn.summary: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಹಿಂಭಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಂಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೇರಳೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕೆಂಪು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಡಿಎಪಿ (DAP) ಅಥವಾ ಮೂಳೆ ಪುಡಿ (Bone meal) ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ನೀಡಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियों और तनों पर गहरा बैंगनी या लाल रंग उभर आता है तथा जड़ें कमजोर रहती हैं।
hi.cure: डी.ए.पी. या सिंगल सुपर फॉस्फेट (SSP) का संतुलित उपयोग करें।

Plant___Potassium_deficiency.causalAgent: Potassium Depletion or Excess Calcium/Magnesium Antagonism
Plant___Potassium_deficiency.symptoms: Marginal chlorosis quickly progressing to scorched, necrotic brown leaf margins ('tip burn' or 'leaf firing') on older mature leaves; curling of leaf tips; weak lodging-prone stems; poor drought tolerance.
Plant___Potassium_deficiency.possibleCauses: Sandy soil leaching; imbalance from heavy calcitic lime or magnesium applications; high crop removal rates.
Plant___Potassium_deficiency.conditions: Drought conditions exacerbating potassium diffusion through soil pore water.
Plant___Potassium_deficiency.observationInterval: Inspect older foliage weekly during fruit set and bulking.
Plant___Potassium_deficiency.whenToConsultExpert: Consult extension agronomist if leaf scorch affects upper canopy or fruit sizing stalls.

organic: Apply wood ash (cautiously, avoid raising pH excessively), kelp meal, or greensand.
Apply Potassium Sulfate (Sulfate of Potash OMRI listed) @ 1.5kg per 100 sq meters.
chemical: Spray foliar Potassium Nitrate (13-0-45) @ 5g/L or Potassium Sulfate @ 5g/L.
Soil apply Muriate of Potash (MOP 0-0-60) or Sulfate of Potash (SOP 0-0-50).
cultural: Maintain uniform soil moisture to facilitate potassium ion movement via mass flow.
Mulch beds to conserve root-zone moisture and reduce thermal stress.
prevention: Conduct annual soil potassium balance testing; replace harvested potassium.

kn.summary: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಅಂಚುಗಳು ಒಣಗಿ ಸುಟ್ಟಂತೆ ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಶಿಯಂ ಸಲ್ಫೇಟ್ (SOP) ಅಥವಾ ಬೂದಿ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಹಾಕಿ.

hi.summary: पत्तियों के किनारे झुलसकर भूरे और सूखे हो जाते हैं।
hi.cure: म्यूरिएट ऑफ पोटाश (MOP) या पोटेशियम सल्फेट का छिड़काव करें।

Plant___Magnesium_deficiency.causalAgent: Magnesium Depletion or High Potassium-to-Magnesium Ratio
Plant___Magnesium_deficiency.symptoms: Striking interveinal chlorosis on older mature leaves where veins remain distinctly green while interveinal areas turn pale yellow to whitish-bronze; leaf margins may curl inward; premature leaf abscission.
Plant___Magnesium_deficiency.possibleCauses: Sandy acidic soils with low CEC; excess potassium or ammonium fertilization antagonizing magnesium uptake.
Plant___Magnesium_deficiency.conditions: Acidic soils (pH < 5.5) or over-application of potash fertilizers.
Plant___Magnesium_deficiency.observationInterval: Inspect lower canopy foliage every 7–10 days during peak fruit/flower development.
Plant___Magnesium_deficiency.whenToConsultExpert: Perform leaf tissue analysis if symptoms persist after Epsom salt application.

organic: Apply agricultural Dolomitic limestone (CaCO3 + MgCO3) to acidic soils (raising pH and supplying Mg).
Spray pharmaceutical grade Epsom salt (Magnesium Sulfate heptahydrate) @ 10g–15g per liter.
chemical: Apply Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4) 1%–2% foliar spray for fast therapeutic greening.
Soil apply Kieserite (MgSO4·H2O) @ 25kg/hectare.
cultural: Balance K:Mg fertilizer ratio (ideal soil exchangeable ratio approximately 3:1 to 5:1).
Avoid excessive calcium and potassium over-fertilization.
prevention: Incorporate dolomitic limestone during soil bed preparation when pH is below 6.0.

sources.title: Secondary Plant Nutrients: Calcium, Magnesium, and Sulfur
sources.organization: University of Florida IFAS Extension EDIS

kn.summary: ಹಳೆಯ ಎಲೆಗಳ ನರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಾಗ ಹಳದಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಆದರೆ ನರಗಳು ಹಸಿರಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.
kn.cure: ಎಪ್ಸಮ್ ಉಪ್ಪು (Epsom salt 15 ಗ್ರಾಂ/ಲೀಟರ್) ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಗಿಸಿ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ.

hi.summary: निचली पत्तियों की नसें हरी रहती हैं और बीच का भाग पीला पड़ जाता है।
hi.cure: एप्सम सॉल्ट (मैग्नीशियम सल्फेट 15 ग्राम/लीटर) का छिड़काव करें।

Plant___Iron_deficiency_chlorosis.causalAgent: Iron (Fe) Immobilization due to Alkaline / Calcareous Soil pH (Immobile Micronutrient)
Plant___Iron_deficiency_chlorosis.symptoms: Sharp interveinal chlorosis appearing selectively on youngest emerging terminal leaves; leaf blade turns pale ivory-yellow while fine network of veins remains intensely green; severe cases cause complete leaf bleaching and apical necrosis.
Plant___Iron_deficiency_chlorosis.possibleCauses: High soil pH (>7.5) precipitating ionic iron into insoluble ferric hydroxides; soil waterlogging; root disease restricting micronutrient uptake.
Plant___Iron_deficiency_chlorosis.conditions: Alkaline or calcareous soils high in free calcium carbonate; cold, saturated spring soils.
Plant___Iron_deficiency_chlorosis.observationInterval: Inspect new shoot flushes and terminal buds every 5–7 days.
Plant___Iron_deficiency_chlorosis.whenToConsultExpert: Consult local extension if foliar iron sprays fail to green new shoots within 10 days.

organic: Foliar spray chelated Iron (Fe-EDDHA or Fe-EDTA 12%) @ 1.0g–1.5g per liter.
Incorporate elemental sulfur or acidic peat moss to lower rhizosphere pH below 6.8.
chemical: Spray Ferrous Sulfate (FeSO4) 0.5% (5g/L) combined with 0.1% citric acid adjuvant.
Soil drench Fe-EDDHA chelate (stable up to pH 9.0) around active root drip line.
cultural: Avoid over-watering and relieve soil compaction to encourage aerobic root respiration.
Avoid excessive phosphorus application which precipitates iron within plant vascular tissue.
prevention: Test soil pH prior to planting; maintain optimal range 6.0–6.8 for micronutrient bioavailability.

sources.title: Iron Chlorosis in Crops and Ornamentals

kn.summary: ಹೊಸ ಎಲೆಗಳ ನರಗಳು ಹಸಿರಾಗಿದ್ದು, ನರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಾಗ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಹಳದಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
kn.cure: ಚೆಲೇಟೆಡ್ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ (Chelated Iron Fe-EDTA 1.5 ಗ್ರಾಂ/ಲೀಟರ್) ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ.

hi.summary: नई पत्तियों की नसें हरी रहती हैं और उनके बीच का हिस्सा पीला पड़ जाता है।
hi.cure: चिलेटेड आयरन (Fe-EDTA 1.5 ग्राम/लीटर) का पत्तियों पर छिड़काव करें।
